# Faff:Naught

> Faff:Naught is a small software studio focused on removing everyday friction, beginning with The Peacemaker.

Faff:Naught is the trading name of Faff Naught Ltd.

The Peacemaker is an Android restaurant bill-splitting app for shared plates and group dining. It supports receipt scanning, editable items, shared-item allocation, tax and tip splitting, and rounding.

- [Faff:Naught](https://faffnaught.com/)
